title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 89-92 (Nrupaveshmagatananda, Varalakshmi, Vasuprada, Shubha)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 89 to 92: Nrupaveshmagatananda, Varalakshmi, Vasuprada, Shubha, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 89 to 92 with meaning
caption: Names 89 to 92 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 89 to 92**: **Nrupaveshmagatananda, Varalakshmi, Vasuprada, Shubha**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Nrupaveshmagatananda, Varalakshmi, Vasuprada, Shubha.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Nrupaveshmagatananda** means **Joy of royal palaces**. She brings joy to palaces: good rule, justice and a prosperous kingdom.
**Varalakshmi** means **Lakshmi who grants boons**. Varalakshmi Vratam in the month of Shravana is the best known worship of this form.
**Vasuprada** means **Giver of wealth**. Giver of treasure and all forms of wealth, as the eight Ashtalakshmi forms.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
